ITEM 1 | Bright green floret cluster with tree-like branching, slightly darker green at the stems, moist-looking surface with small bumpy buds, sitting at the upper left of the plate, roughly 6 cm across, about 2.5 cm tall | 45
ITEM 2 | Two smaller bright green florets with fine bumpy buds and a pale stem base, grouped beside the larger floret cluster at the left edge of the plate, each about 3 cm across | 25
ITEM 3 | Several medium-green florets clustered together in the center-left, slightly paler at the stem ends, with a crisp-looking, bumpy surface, about 5 cm across and 2.5 cm tall | 35
ITEM 4 | Dark green, glossy, wilted leaves with thin pale yellow-green stems, spread in a loose heap across the lower-center of the plate, mostly flat with some folds, covering roughly 25 percent of the plate, about 1 cm thick at the thickest point, slightly moist sheen | 90
ITEM 5 | Pinkish-brown cooked meat in irregular chunks and shreds, some browned edges and darker patches, with pale whitish-tan bits (likely fat or softened onion-like pieces) mixed in, glistening slightly, piled in a mound on the right side of the plate, about 10 cm across and 1.5 to 2 cm tall | 110
ITEM 6 | Small pale yellow-tan translucent pieces and fine bits scattered among the meat and greens, slightly glossy, possibly oil residue or cooked aromatics, spread thinly over about 5 percent of the plate | 8
